items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...I heard, though, that Eva Taylor, his wife, had left him or something. [INTERVIEWEE] No, she, she, oh, she didn't have been separated a long time.

ctx.x: When I left there, he was doing all right. He was the only Negro in the country at a pawn shop.
Oh, yes. You can put it up on here. Oh, yeah. Put it down up on there, okay? I've been out of the way around. I heard, though, that Eva Taylor, his wife, had left him or something.
No, she, she, oh, she didn't have been separated a long time. Well, they had been, I don't know.
